meaning:
ναυαγέω, -ῶ
(ναῦς, + ἄγνυμι, to break)
to suffer shipwreck: 2Co.11:25; metaphorically, before περὶ τ. πίστιν, 1Ti.1:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
